digest.component_or_area: codebase structure, CI reliability, and typing ratchet
propositions: CI test flake in test_opcert_service_app under xdist causes worker teardown race on host contention, leaving benign noise but blocking builds
assignee documentation example teaches unresolvable bare handle inconsistent with docs/config.md
structured_run.py, compact.py, and event_append.py near 800-line cap violate separation-of-concerns with mixed responsibilities and duplicated infrastructure across call sites

graph traversal subsystem (_find_direct_blockers, _get_all_blocked_by, check_cycle_at_level, detect_newly_unblocked) exhibits high cyclomatic complexity due to duplicated loader/BFS logic across four functions
attest package lacks type annotations under --disallow-untyped-defs and blocks ratchet enforcement
